scope: Counterbalanced three fresh-process trials per pinned engineering profile, two isolated bundle materializations, same host and fixtures. Warm filesystem/module startup separated from request latency. All response bodies and writing authority equal, mutations denied, real persisted session/reload/revocation assertions pass. Local engineering measurement only, no production SLO or browser claim.

Not browser paint, remote network, production concurrency, cold disk or an SLO.
